designSequence.waveName: Dependency, Packaging, and Public API Architecture

purpose: Finalize GPWCF dependency ownership and allowed/forbidden dependency directions across Core, optional Supporting Patterns, Prefect Integration, consumers, and the SMRB development environment, including the newly justified identity and diagnostics modules.

included: Runtime, build, development, test, and verification dependency ownership.
The Core/optional pattern/Prefect Integration/consumer dependency graph.
The canonical identity and optional diagnostics module allocation.
The minimal Prefect Integration direct/transitive dependency policy.
Installation profiles and environment isolation guarantees.
The treatment of SMRB .dependencies and shared .env.
excluded: Reconsideration of the accepted Prefect 3.9.2 integration decision.
Concrete packaging artifact layout and build backend configuration, detailed in 15,00_Packaging.json.
Exact public import/export names, detailed in 16.00_Public_API_Architecture.json.
Any new runtime service, manager, registry, or mandatory external infrastructure not required by an approved contract.

governingPrinciples: Dependency ownership follows semantic and operational responsibility, not repository proximity or current developer environment installation.
Core runtime imports remain standard-library-only in the current baseline.
Prefect 3.9.2 is an accepted optional external runtime owned only by integrations.prefect.
Optional Supporting Patterns remain separately importable and are required only when selected by a concrete Step.
SMRB .dependencies and .env remain shared developer environment assets and are not GPWCF package runtime dependencies.
Build/test/verification tools are isolated from runtime dependency metadata.
No GPWCF-local .dependencies directory or duplicate dependency bundle is created.
No generic core.shared_contracts catch-all module is created; each cross-module contract must have a named cohesive owner.
Dependency graph remains inward and acyclic.

dependencyOwners.runtimeGuarantee: Core installation/import requires only the Python standard library in the current baseline.
mustNotDependOn: Prefect or any external workflow runtime.
Generator modules, private assets, or pygccxml.
Consumer business models or consumer-specific error vocabulary.
SMRB .dependencies contents as implicit runtime dependencies.
C++ vcpkg dependencies or native toolchains.
External API server, database, queue, broker, or worker service.

dependencyOwners.responsibility: Canonical immutable nominal identity value types used across Pipeline invocation correlation, Stage, Step, SPU, selected Supporting Patterns, and integration correlation boundaries.
dependencyOwners.semanticOwnership: Each Entity/Aggregate or consumer remains the authority for issuing, validating, accepting, retaining, and retiring its own identity values. The module owns only the canonical value type definitions.

dependencyOwners.responsibility: A narrow typed descriptive Diagnostic[TDetails] value contract.
mustNotProvide: Logger, collector, event bus, or diagnostic registry.
dependencyOwners.consumptionRule: Only specialized contracts that explicitly choose to use Diagnostic import this optional module. No mandatory Core result envelope depends on it.

dependencyOwners.dependencyRule: Each pattern owns its specialized callable/result/association/lifecycle contracts. A concrete Step depends only on selected pattern contract surfaces.
mustNotDependOn: Generator Common Error Model as a generic dependency.
Other optional patterns unless a specialized contract explicitly requires the relationship.
dependencyOwners.currentDependencyEvidence: No third-party runtime dependency is currently evidenced for the generic pattern contract packages.

dependencyOwners.transitiveRuntimeDependencies: Must be resolved from Prefect 3.9.2 package metadata in a clean isolated Integration environment, then minimized, version/hash locked, license-reviewed, and tested.
mayDependOn: Prefect 3.9.2 and its verified transitive runtime closure.
Selected optional pattern Public API contracts where a binding is implemented.
mustNotDependOn: Consumer business modules or Generator-private assets.
Unqualified external services as mandatory package prerequisites.
dependencyOwners.installationRule: Opt-in only. Installing/importing Core must not install/import Prefect or integrations.prefect.

modules: Consumer-specific Error Models and business policies
dependencyOwners.dependencyRule: Consumer dependencies remain declared by the consumer project. They are not promoted into GPWCF Core or Prefect Integration.
mayDependOn: Prefect Integration Public API when selected.
Its own business, extraction, and deployment dependencies.
mustNotDependOn: Prefect private internals outside the Prefect Integration Public API.

assets: Repository-root vcpkg.json and C++ MSBuild integration
dependencyOwners.role: Coordinates developer setup and aggregates requirements of solution-owned tools. It is not a consumer installation profile or GPWCF runtime dependency.
mustNotDo: Create GPWCF/.dependencies as a duplicate dependency store.
Copy the shared .env into the GPWCF package.
Promote every installed solution package into Core runtime metadata.
Assume every asset under .dependencies ships to consumers.
Treat vcpkg dependencies as Python package runtime dependencies.

dependencyOwners.rule: Guidance creates no runtime package, service, manager, or installation requirement.

dependencyOwners.status: Excluded from baseline Core until genericity and dependency closure are approved.
dependencyOwners.rule: The current Generator Common Error Model and clauses coupled to its vocabulary are not promoted into Core. Genericization requires a separately versioned contract, explicit ownership, dependency closure, and Public API review.

allowedDependencyEdges.rule: Stage Composition invokes the Step public callable contract; Stage must not depend directly on SPU.
Stage uses canonical Stage and invocation identity value types.
StageResult and Stage-specific Flow Result typing are owned by Stage; no universal FlowResult module is created.
Step Composition owns SPU selection/invocation and StepExecutionResult assembly.
StepExecutionResult and OptionalResultContributions are owned by the Step result module.
Step uses canonical Step and parent Stage invocation identity value types without importing Stage implementation.
Only the concrete Step's selected optional pattern contract surfaces are imported.
StageResult carries canonical Stage and invocation identity values.
StepExecutionResult carries canonical Step and parent Stage invocation identity values.
SPU identity value types are imported without depending on Step implementation.
Selected pattern contracts use canonical unit/association/invocation/operation identity values.
A specialized contract may use Diagnostic[TDetails] when useful; this dependency is never mandatory for Core results.
Prefect Integration binds supported public contracts and maps invocation/context/result/identity.
External runtime dependency is isolated to the opt-in Prefect Integration.
Consumer owns concrete specializations and business policies.
Consumer uses this API only when Prefect Integration is selected; no consumer depends on Integration internals.

forbiddenDependencyEdges.reason: Would make Core import/installation dependent on the external workflow runtime.
Would invert ownership and couple the framework to one consumer.
Stage coordinates the Step public contract only; Step owns internal SPU composition.
Would create a reverse dependency/cycle; parent Stage correlation is carried through core.identities value types.
SPU is a standalone callable processing entity; Step consumes the SPU contract, not vice versa.

forbiddenDependencyEdges.to: Concrete optional Supporting Pattern result package
forbiddenDependencyEdges.reason: Optional result types are generic type parameters; importing every pattern would destroy optionality.
Current Error Model is consumer-specific and dependency closure is not approved.
Shared development environment assets are not package runtime contracts.

forbiddenDependencyEdges.to: Prefect State or native run/task IDs
forbiddenDependencyEdges.reason: Domain results and identities remain independent from native operational records.
Step Composition consumes the pattern contract; optional pattern modules do not import their consumer's implementation.

installationProfiles.name: Core-only consumer
guarantees: No Generator or pygccxml installation required.
Core Public API usable without Prefect imports.
Unselected Supporting Patterns need not be imported.

installationProfiles.name: Core plus Prefect Integration
installationProfiles.deploymentProfile: PHASE-02 used a local Prefect API server backed by SQLite and two Process Workers; these are deployment/operations, not Core installation dependencies.
installationProfiles.lockRequirement: A minimized, cleanly reconstructed, version/hash-controlled transitive lock is required before release.
guarantees: Prefect IDs/State remain operational evidence, not GPWCF domain identities/results.

installationProfiles.name: Core plus selected Supporting Patterns
installationProfiles.installCommand: pip install gpwcf; import only the selected gpwcf.public_api.core.supporting_patterns.* submodules
required: Only selected optional Supporting Pattern contracts/implementations
guarantees: Unselected optional pattern packages are not imported.
No optional pattern becomes a mandatory Core dependency.
Current generic pattern contracts have no evidenced third-party runtime requirement.

installationProfiles.name: PayloadDescriptionGenerator consumer
required: GPWCF Prefect Integration when Prefect is used
installationProfiles.rule: Generator dependencies remain declared by Generator-owned requirements and are aggregated at SMRB solution root only for developer setup.

installationProfiles.name: SMRB solution developer environment
required: Relevant solution build tools and vcpkg-managed C++ dependencies
installationProfiles.rule: This profile may aggregate multiple tool requirements for convenience. It is not a consumer installation profile and is not evidence of Core or Integration runtime dependency closure.

prefectDependencyQualification.adoptionDecision: Accepted and settled: Prefect 3.9.2 is the initial pinned external workflow runtime under ADR-GPWCF-PREFECT-001.

environmentEvidence.interpretation: Complete environment snapshot including packages not required by the minimal PoC; not a minimized Integration lock or proof all 106 packages are required.

deploymentDependenciesNotPackageBaseDepe: SQLite persistence used by qualified local profile.
Process Worker processes and Work Pool.
prefectDependencyQualification.qualifiedOperationalProfile: Windows x64, CPython 3.15.1, Prefect 3.9.2, local SQLite API server, Process Work Pool, two Process Workers with flow-run limit 1, two Stage Deployments.
requiredBeforeRelease: Create a clean isolated environment for Integration only.
Install exact direct requirement prefect==3.9.2 and capture resolver-produced transitive closure.
Separate runtime packages from PoC/developer/test/documentation/optional-service packages using clean imports and profile-specific tests.
Record exact versions and hashes in a reproducible lock; review licenses and Python/platform markers.
Prove Core install/import with Prefect absent and Integration import/run with the locked Prefect environment.
Do not add optional API-server database backends, distributed queues, cloud services, or worker infrastructure unless the chosen deployment profile explicitly requires them.

developmentBuildAndVerificationDependenc.principle: Development/build/test/verification tools are not runtime dependencies unless the shipped package imports or executes them at runtime.

currentEvidence.gpwcfRequirements: Current GPWCF requirements.txt contains comments only and declares no third-party requirements.
currentEvidence.sharedEnvironment: SMRB .dependencies/README.md describes one shared .env and solution-level aggregation.
currentEvidence.testTooling: No GPWCF-specific third-party test/build/type-check dependency is declared in the reviewed GPWCF requirements file; do not invent one here.

selectedBuildBackend.classification: isolated build-system dependency only; not a GPWCF runtime dependency.
basis: Setuptools 84.2.1 declares Python >=3.10 support and its release history includes Python 3.15 build support.
The official setuptools build-system documentation identifies setuptools.build_meta as its PEP 517 backend.
selectedBuildBackend.verificationGate: Run a clean isolated sdist/wheel build and install smoke test under the actual CPython 3.15.1 x64 Windows environment before implementing pyproject.toml.

buildFrontend.version: Pin in the development/build lock after the project test/build toolchain is selected; do not add to runtime dependencies.

ownershipRules: Core runtime metadata contains no third-party dependency in the current baseline.
Prefect Integration runtime metadata contains the optional prefect==3.9.2 requirement and only its verified closure.
Build backend is declared under [build-system] and is installed in an isolated build environment.
Test/type-check/lint/documentation tools remain in development configuration/lock and are excluded from runtime metadata.
Generator tooling remains declared by Generator requirements.
SMRB root requirements remains an aggregator, not the authoritative owner of individual tool dependencies.
vcpkg dependencies remain C++ build dependencies, not Python package requirements.

verificationProfiles.requirements: Core only, no Prefect or Generator dependencies; verify Core Public API and import graph.
Core plus one selected optional pattern at a time; verify unselected patterns are not imported/required.
Core plus pinned Prefect Integration dependency lock; verify Integration imports and native runtime.
Core plus Integration when selected plus consumer-owned requirements; verify no consumer dependency leaks into framework packages.
Build sdist and wheel in an isolated environment with only the pinned build backend; install the artifacts into clean Core-only and Core-plus-Prefect environments.

dependencyAndImportInvariants: Core runtime imports are standard-library-only in the current baseline.
Core Public API import succeeds in an environment where Prefect is not installed.
Importing Core does not import integrations.prefect or any Prefect package.
Prefect Integration imports Core only through Core Public API, not Core internals.
Prefect imports remain within the opt-in Integration boundary.
Optional Supporting Pattern APIs are separately importable and not eagerly imported by Core root or Step result module.
Step Composition consumes only selected Supporting Pattern contract surfaces; pattern modules do not import Step Composition implementation.
No consumer or Generator code is imported by Core or Integration.
No Generator Common Error Model, pygccxml, or Generator extraction engine is installed by Core or Integration.
No broad core.shared_contracts package is created; core.identities and core.diagnostics each have a narrow explicit purpose and ownership.
No package imports Prefect State as a substitute for SPUExecutionResult, StepExecutionResult, or StageResult.
The Public API surface, not private implementation paths, is the compatibility boundary.

changes: Add MOD-CORE-IDENTITIES as mandatory_standalone and dependency-free.
Add MOD-CORE-DIAGNOSTICS as optional_reusable and dependency-free.
Add StageResult under MOD-CORE-STAGE and StepExecutionResult/OptionalResultContributions under MOD-CORE-STEP-RESULTS.
Record allowed dependency edges from Stage, Step, SPU, and selected Supporting Patterns to core.identities.
Record the optional dependency edge to core.diagnostics only when a specialized contract selects it.
Keep MOD-CORE-SHARED-CONTRACTS not_established and do not create a broad shared package.
Add Stage-owned core/stage/results and invocation/contracts/lifecycle allocations justified by Wave 1.
Add Step contracts/invocation/lifecycle/results allocations justified by Wave 2.
Add SPU generic result type allocations justified by Wave 3.
Align Prefect integration subpackages to Wave 5 binding/correlation/results/configuration allocations.
Make pyproject.toml required because the selected packaging design uses PEP 621 and setuptools PEP 517 build metadata.
Update dependency owner/module lists and dependency graph with core.identities and core.diagnostics.
Replace the unresolved distribution arrangement with one distribution and optional Prefect extra for the initial release.
Record setuptools==84.2.1 / setuptools.build_meta as isolated build-system dependency.
Preserve Prefect 3.9.2 as optional runtime extra and keep minimal transitive lock as a release gate.
Update Public API readiness gaps resolved by Waves 1-4 while retaining production integration/failure qualification gates.

acceptanceCriteria: Every runtime/build/development dependency has one explicit owner.
Core remains standard-library-only and installable without Prefect, Generator dependencies, or SMRB development assets.
core.identities is a narrow dependency-free module for nominal identity value types only.
core.diagnostics is optional and does not become a universal Error Model.
Optional Supporting Patterns remain independent and opt-in.
Prefect 3.9.2 remains the accepted integration runtime and is installed only through the optional Prefect profile.
The 106-package environment snapshot is not treated as the minimal Integration dependency closure.
Dependency graph is acyclic and all forbidden directions remain prohibited.
The single-distribution optional-extra packaging choice preserves the Core-only installation/import guarantee.
Build backend dependencies remain isolated from runtime dependencies.
The exact Prefect transitive lock and clean isolated build verification remain explicit release gates.
No source package or specialized contract is modified by this design artifact.

changeControl.authority: Wave 6 dependency architecture proposal. It becomes an implementation constraint only after review and explicit acceptance.
changeControl.sourceContractPolicy: This artifact does not modify the current Dependency_and_Public_API_Architecture.json, Framework_Module_Boundary_Model.json, or Filesystem_Architecture.json; it records required reconciliation changes.
changeControl.implementationGate: Do not create pyproject.toml or install new project build dependencies until all Wave 6 artifacts and governing-artifact reconciliation are accepted.
changeControl.nextStep: Design 15,00_Packaging.json with the selected distribution arrangement, build backend, metadata, optional extras, lock strategy, and build/test installation profiles.
